normal.label: No obvious abnormality detected
focus_reasoning: The AI analysis did not detect an obvious abnormality pattern.
Recommended focus is general hand and wrist mobility and light strengthening to preserve function.
normal.notes: Continue general mobility routines. Report new pain or loss of function to a clinician.

abnormal_fracture_suspicion.label: Possible fracture / bone disruption pattern
focus_reasoning: The AI model flagged a bone-disruption pattern that can be consistent with a fracture.
Active rehabilitation is NOT recommended before a clinician confirms the diagnosis.
Focus is restricted, pain-free active range-of-motion of unaffected segments only.
abnormal_fracture_suspicion.notes: This finding requires clinical evaluation. Do not begin strengthening, weight-bearing or gripping.

abnormal_degenerative_changes.label: Possible degenerative joint changes
abnormal_degenerative_changes.rehab_focus: Joint mobility, flexibility and low-load strengthening
focus_reasoning: The AI analysis suggests changes consistent with degenerative joint patterns (e.g., osteoarthritic changes).
Focus on pain-free range-of-motion, then progress to low-load strengthening.
abnormal_degenerative_changes.notes: Keep movements within a pain-free range and avoid forceful end-range stretches.

abnormal_soft_tissue_swelling.label: Possible soft-tissue swelling pattern
focus_reasoning: The AI analysis suggests increased soft-tissue signal consistent with swelling.
Prioritize gentle, pain-free motion and elevation guidance; strength work should wait.
abnormal_soft_tissue_swelling.notes: If swelling is significant or worsening, seek clinical evaluation.

abnormal_generic.label: Abnormal pattern (unspecified)
abnormal_generic.rehab_focus: Gentle mobility and strengthening under clinical guidance
focus_reasoning: The AI analysis detected an abnormal pattern but could not confidently subclassify it.
Begin with gentle, pain-free mobility and strengthening, and confirm findings with a clinician.
abnormal_generic.notes: Confirm AI findings with clinical assessment before progressing intensity.

wrist.label: Wrist
movement_requirements: Move only within a pain-free range of motion
Perform slow, controlled movements without jerking
Rest between sets; avoid overexertion of the wrist joint

hand.label: Hand
hand.focus_phrase: finger dexterity and intrinsic hand muscle function
movement_requirements: Perform movements slowly with full available range
Avoid forced stretching of stiff or painful joints
Maintain a neutral wrist position during finger exercises when possible

fingers.label: Fingers
movement_requirements: Isolate each finger joint where possible
Stop immediately if sharp pain occurs

disclaimer: This is an AI-assisted research/prototype system. It does not provide a medical diagnosis and does not replace evaluation by a qualified physician or physiotherapist. Recommendations are generated from a structured, clinician-reviewed exercise knowledge base and must be confirmed with a healthcare professional before use.
